items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Johnny Beresdorf was up there playing good trumpet too.

ctx.x: What about George Horton? Was he playing trumpet there? He played trumpet.

He also played bass, but primarily trumpet. And in fact he played some darn good trumpet as I remember. Some really good New Orleans trumpet. But it was a hard thing to get into. Johnny Beresdorf was up there playing good trumpet too. But one thing I noticed about most of the New Orleans guys, with very few exceptions, they were pining for New Orleans all the time. Longing to get back and it didn't take much to convince them that they belonged back to New Orleans. That's a trait peculiar to the city. The people…
Well, there's something unique about the town. It's got to be.
